title: AI Based Web Designing – Foundation
subtitle: 3 months · 12 weeks · Foundation / Beginner
summary: Build your Web Designing and UI/UX foundation from scratch: Figma, design principles, typography, colour, wireframing, UI components, landing pages, website UI design and a first portfolio.
expert: At the end you can design a complete, structured website interface in Figma, explain your design choices, and present it professionally on Behance.

benchmarks.title: Fundamentals
benchmarks.detail: Understand the fundamentals of Web Designing and UI/UX.

benchmarks.title: Figma
benchmarks.detail: Work confidently with Figma and its core design tools.

benchmarks.title: Visual design
benchmarks.detail: Apply typography, colour, spacing, grids and basic design principles.

benchmarks.title: Structure
benchmarks.detail: Create wireframes, user flows and structured website layouts.

benchmarks.title: Interfaces
benchmarks.detail: Design landing pages and complete website interfaces with buttons, forms and cards.

benchmarks.title: Portfolio
benchmarks.detail: Analyse design inspiration, present design work professionally and build the foundation of a UI/UX portfolio.

stages.title: Web Design & UI/UX Fundamentals
stages.goal: Understand how websites are planned and how users interact with them, and get comfortable in Figma.
stages.doneWhen: You can explain UI vs UX with real examples, work in Figma frames and layers, and have a mood board for your own website idea.
